meta.title: Sign in — Forge AI
meta.description: Sign in to the Forge AI platform.

signIn.heading: Sign in
signIn.intro: Your account ID identifies your organisation. It is on your welcome email and in the footer of any Forge AI report.

accountAlias.label: Account ID
accountAlias.hint: Your organisation's short code, exactly as issued — letters, numbers or hyphens
accountAlias.format: An account ID is 3–50 letters, numbers or hyphens.

email.label: Email address
email.hint: The address your account was created with
email.format: Enter a complete email address, including the @.

errors.summaryTitle: {count, plural, one {There is # problem with these details} other {There are # problems with these details}}
errors.rejected: Those details did not match an account. Check the account ID, then the email address and password.
errors.invalidRequest: Check the account ID and email address — one of them was not in a form we could read.
errors.locked: This account is temporarily locked after too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes, or contact your site administrator.
errors.unavailable: Cannot reach the platform right now. Check the connection and try again.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session ended, so you were signed out. Sign in again to pick up where you left off.

security.note: Forge AI never asks for your password by email or over the phone.
